name: Hip Thrust
common_faults: chin to chest instead of neutral neck

substitutions.note: hinge pattern; more hamstring and back demand
full posterior-chain demand; adds spinal load

contraindications: acute hip flexor injury at full extension
resistance_profile: hardest at full hip extension; glute is maximally shortened and loaded at lockout

provenance.notes: Contreras et al. research supports hip thrust as high-EMG glute exercise at terminal extension. SFR high relative to systemic load. Load placement on hip can be uncomfortable without padding.
